updateTime.description: Date and time when this consolidated metric document was last updated by the consolidation engine

name.description: Raw metric name from the source, parsed to derive the metric, product type, mission and satellite unit (e.g. Archived.<productType>.<mission>.<unit>.<metricType>)

metric_name.description: Metric action derived from the raw name, such as archived or download

metric_type.description: Type of the metric as provided by the source

mission.description: Short mission name derived from the metric name (e.g. S1, S2)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit derived from the metric name (e.g. S1A)

product_type.description: Product type derived from the metric name

interface_name.description: Name of the interface the metric originates from

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service associated with the metric

production_service_name.description: Name of the production service associated with the metric
